engine.notes: The East Valley has three improv theatres within a few miles of each other: NCT on Main Street, JesterZ (Mesa's longest-running troupe, now in downtown Gilbert) and The Bridge on Dobson Road. Mic Drop Comedy in Chandler and Tempe Improv are stand-up clubs.

entries.name: The Neighborhood Comedy Theatre
entries.summary: Downtown Mesa's improv and sketch theatre, staging over 300 shows a year on Main Street, with six class levels from Intro to Musical Improv and pay-what-you-want jams every Friday and Saturday evening.
entries.schedule: Shows every weekend; jams Fri & Sat 6pm, pay what you want; new six-week sessions about every nine weeks
signals: Six levels, $200 per six-week class, through The Harold and Musical Improv
Process Lab and Indie Night as the path onto the stage
Jams every Friday and Saturday with a different form each week
Site news dated Sep 29 and Oct 14, 2026
entries.reasons: A permanent Main Street home, the deepest class ladder in the East Valley, shows every weekend and two jams a week; it does not publish its founding year or seat count.

entries.name: JesterZ Improv Comedy
entries.summary: The East Valley's clean, alcohol-free improv theatre since 2001, long based in Mesa and now in downtown Gilbert, with two shows every Friday and Saturday and eight-week adult classes that end on its stage.
signals: Adult (16+) eight-week sessions finish with a live show
entries.reasons: A quarter century of weekend shows, its own venue and classes for every age that culminate in performing; the site is current but publishes no specific class dates.

entries.name: The Bridge Improv Theater
entries.summary: A clean-comedy improv theater opened in 2020 on Dobson Road with two shows every Friday and Saturday, a Saturday happy-hour jam and adult and youth classes.
entries.schedule: Mainstage Fri & Sat 7pm; Bridge Block Party Fri & Sat 8:30pm; Happy Hour Jam Saturdays 6pm
entries.reasons: Its own room and four shows a weekend plus a weekly jam, but it is six years old and the class pages give no levels, dates or prices.
